summary: The user sent 93588.863044 USDT to ChangeHero for an ERC20 to TRC20 exchange and the transaction was placed on hold. The user reported completing requested KYC and AML verification but the platform had neither processed the swap nor refunded the deposited funds.
user_mistake: sent a large crypto amount through an exchange service without first confirming completion of a smaller swap
prevention: Complete a small exchange and withdrawal before transferring a large amount / Preserve transaction records and compliance correspondence if funds are withheld
classification_warning: insufficient detail to confirm intentional scam
